entries.note: [budget-bump: core] Canvas renderer + ARIA shadow + FenwickHeights + selection + editing. Raised from 30720 to match the measured 36.27 KB the v1.2 interaction waves (24-26: find/replace, row drag-reorder, mid-table pinning, overlays, auto-size, Excel keyboard nav) actually cost — the budget had not been re-measured since those landed, so the gate was failing on shipped, intended work rather than on a regression. Headroom is deliberately thin (~10%): this is the bundle every adopter pays for. New optional features go in a dist/feature/* sub-path entry below, not here.
Merged cells (row + column span) — opt-in via `@onegrid/core/span`.
Colour scales / data bars / icon sets — opt-in via `@onegrid/core/conditional-format`.
Tree/group-aware + multi-row drag reorder — opt-in via `@onegrid/core/reorder`.
Header wrap + page-level sticky header + column-group visibility — opt-in via `@onegrid/core/layout`.
Multi-value chip cell type + popover editor — opt-in via `@onegrid/core/multi-select`.
